title: Pierre Deligne Papers: Modern LaTeX Drafts and English Translation Drafts
version: 2026-05-31 Deligne working record: Paper 32 corrected source layer
description:
Dedicated Deligne record for the Modern LaTeX Editions of Mathematics Manuscripts project. This page is separate from the main corpus so Deligne material can be cited, revised, or reorganized independently.

The top-level files are reader-facing. The first PDFs are cumulative working readers for the Deligne papers touched so far: one English translation reader and one French source/working-LaTeX reader. Individual English paper PDFs and selected French source/working PDFs are also exposed for direct download. Broader reference PDFs and TeX/source artifacts are kept in ZIP files rather than cluttering the front-facing reader list.

Status at a glance. [######----] active touched-paper stream: 14 paper-level English working translations are in the current cumulative reader; [###-------] French source or working-LaTeX top-level readers are present for Papers 32, 84, and 85, with broader original/reference material preserved in ZIP artifacts; [##########] original/reference and provenance material is preserved. Paper 32 now uses a corrected 116-page original-language source/reference layer; its English reader was rebuilt with a corrected Theorem (6.2.13) support condition. These are working scholarly transcriptions and translation drafts, not proofed critical editions.

Workflow provenance: public scans and source witnesses are converted into TeX, checked and organized locally, then packaged here with source artifacts so readers can inspect, correct, and reuse the work. The public organization is by paper and work status.
notes: Latest update promotes a corrected Paper 32 Weil II source/reference layer and rebuilt English reader, then refreshes the Deligne cumulative readers and artifact ZIP.
